name: Pheneturide
summary: Pheneturide (INN, BAN), also known as phenylethylacetylurea (or ethylphenacemide), is an anticonvulsant of the ureide class. Conceptually, it can be formed in the body as a metabolic degradation product from phenobarbital. It is considered to be obsolete and is now seldom used. It is marketed in Europe, including in Poland, Spain and the United Kingdom.

pharmacology.text: Pheneturide inhibits the metabolism and thus increases the levels of other anticonvulsants, such as phenytoin.

uses.text: It is considered to be obsolete and is now seldom used. It is marketed in Europe, including in Poland, Spain and the United Kingdom.

summaryZh: 苯丁醯脲是脲類抗驚厥藥。從概念上講，它可以作為苯巴比妥的代謝降解產物在體內形成。它被認為已過時，現在很少使用。它在歐洲各國銷售，包括波蘭、西班牙和英國。與苯乙醯脲相比，苯丁醯脲具有相似的抗驚厥活性和毒性。因此，它僅在其他毒性較小的藥物失敗的嚴重癲癇病例中使用。

sideEffects.en: Reported problems include drowsiness, unsteadiness, rash, liver damage and falls in blood cell counts. It also slows the breakdown of other epilepsy medicines, raising their levels.
sideEffects.zh: 已報告的問題包括嗜睡、步態不穩、皮疹、肝損傷與血球數下降。它也會減緩其他抗癲癇藥的分解，使其血中濃度上升。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已报告的问题包括嗜睡、步态不稳、皮疹、肝损伤与血球数下降。它也会减缓其他抗癫痫药的分解，使其血中浓度上升。

fact.en: It is the ethyl version of phenacemide, and in theory the body could form it from the epilepsy drug phenylethylmalonamide.
fact.zh: 它是苯乙醯脲的乙基版本，理論上人體可由抗癲癇藥苯乙基丙二醯胺生成它。
fact.zhHans: 它是苯乙酰脲的乙基版本，理论上人体可由抗癫痫药苯乙基丙二酰胺生成它。
